Perks › Rare

Pip Shift

Rare perk · Active ability

Once per hand per stack, drag one pip across a bone's divider. Values stay within 0–6. The shifted bone becomes public and must be played this turn.

In-game card text

How it works

Once per hand for each copy, drag one pip across a bone's divider: one half loses a pip and the other gains it. The total stays the same, and no half can go below 0 or above 6. Doubles can be split too (3-3 can become 2-4).

  • The game only lets you confirm a change that makes the bone playable right now.
  • The shifted bone becomes public (Rival sees it), and you must play it this turn. You cannot draw or play another bone first.
  • Perks then see the shifted bone: a 2-4 shifted to 3-3 counts as a double for Double Trouble and Golden Double.
  • Pip Shuffle is the stronger version that moves any number of pips.
